title: Clipped grid loop never terminates when v.scale == 0 (minimized/0x0 window): `x += tile` with tile == 0 under a `<=` bound
detail: view_compute sets `v.scale = min(sx, sy)` with no floor; from_screen's own `if v.scale <= 0 { return 0, 0 } // minimized-window guard` proves scale==0 is reachable. map_draw's only early return guards world dims (w/h), not scale. At a 0x0 window: tile==0, x0==x1==0, `0 <= 0` true, `x += 0` — infinite loop freezing the app. The pre-change `for x < f32(v.win_w)` was immediately false at win_w==0, so this hang is diff-introduced.
recommended_fix: Guard before the grid loops: `if tile <= 0 { return }` (or `if v.scale <= 0 { return }` after the span-fill), restoring the pre-change termination behavior for zero-scale frames.
